plan: Store a module-level initial-session template and copy it for construction, begin, and abandon so resets are always identical.
Copy the appointments sequence (and each entry) at construction; build choice dictionaries fresh per screen in input order.
Route every emitted screen through one _screen builder that fixes the key set to prompt/messages/choices and attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Derive the 'next unmet' prompt from session state in _current_prompt (contact -> appointment -> review), reused for corrections and for error-screen prompts.

In handle, dispatch on action['type'] with guard-then-mutate ordering: all validation (session phase, field presence, strict bool/known-id checks) happens before any assignment, so rejected actions leave accepted data untouched and return an 'Error: ...' screen instead of raising.

Implement run_once to verify both injected collaborators up front (RuntimeError before any call), then read one action, handle it, display the screen once, and return the same screen object so unittest fakes can assert identity.
mechanisms: Initial-session template copied for construction/begin/abandon resets
Constructor-time defensive copy of appointments; per-screen choice materialization in input order
Single screen-builder enforcing the exact key set and the choices-iff-'Choose appointment' invariant
State-derived prompt function computing the next unmet step
Guard-then-mutate action dispatch producing 'Error:' screens without state corruption or exceptions
Dependency-injected action_source/screen_sink with fail-fast RuntimeError and identity-returned screen in run_once
